Class Point3D

java.lang.Object
sysmlinjava.common.SysMLAnything
sysmlinjava.attributetypes.SysMLAttributeType
sysmlinjava.attributetypes.Point3D
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, ObservableAttribute
public class Point3D extends SysMLAttributeType implements Serializable
SysMLinJava value type for the cartesian coordinate in two dimensional euclidean space in terms of an x and y coordinates expressed as Java double values

Note: as an ObservableValue this value type can be "observed" by other objects. ValueObservers call the addValueObserver() operation to be notified (called-back) by the Point2D object of any change in its value. This notification will only occur if and when the Point2D value is changed by a call to the setValue() operation. So, while the Point2D.value is publicly accessible and can be changed by direct assignment, the setValue() operation must be used if ValueObservers are to be automatically notified of any change.
